name: taskpig-monorepo
description: TaskPig monorepo: Tauri app, plugin SDK, and bundled plugins

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@taskpig/plugin-sdk && npm run build --workspace=@taskpig/plugin-i18n && npm run build --workspace=taskpig
scripts.build:sdk: npm run build --workspace=@taskpig/plugin-sdk && npm run build --workspace=@taskpig/plugin-i18n
scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace=@taskpig/plugin-sdk && npm run build --workspace=@taskpig/plugin-i18n && npm run dev --workspace=taskpig
scripts.lint: node scripts/check-i18n.mjs && node --test "scripts/**/*.test.mjs" && npm run lint --workspaces --if-present
